nodes.label: Recent Borrow Versus Liquidation Overlap Probe
nodes.norm_label: recent borrow versus liquidation overlap probe

nodes.label: Borrower Discovery State
nodes.rationale: Known borrowers are persisted per chain so the bot does not have to rescan full Borrow-event history every cycle; complete candidate discovery is described as the biggest driver of seeing liquidatable positions.

nodes.label: Watchlist State
nodes.rationale: Near-threshold wallets and the full-sweep cycle counter are persisted so restarts do not reset stratification and force a full sweep on every restart.

nodes.label: Atomic JSON Persistence
nodes.rationale: State is written to a temp file and renamed so a crash during write cannot corrupt the store and force a full re-backfill.

nodes.label: Health Factor Sweep Acceleration
nodes.rationale: Multicall3 batches many getUserAccountData reads into fewer RPC round-trips, turning multi-minute health-factor sweeps into short runs.
